title: Binance Clubhouse Returns to Token2049 Dubai
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians,  Binance is pleased to announce the return of the  Binance Clubhouse  at  Token2049 Dubai , bringing together attendees from across the global blockchain and crypto community. As  one of the title sponsors  of this year’s event, Binance is dedicated   to fostering collaboration, and meaningful discussions within the Web3 ecosystem. The   Binance Clubhouse   will take place from  2025-04-30 to 2025-05-01  and will be hosted at the  Madinat Jumeirah , offering an exclusive space designed for networking, industry insight, and engaging activities. Open to the public daily, the Clubhouse will feature a curated lineup of events aimed at uniting crypto enthusiasts and industry leaders. What to Expect at Binance Clubhouse The Binance Clubhouse provides a dynamic environment tailored for both seasoned professionals and newcomers in the space. Key highlights include: Co-Working & Networking Spaces : A dedicated area for attendees to connect, collaborate, and work in a relaxed setting. Insightful Talks & Special Guests : Hear from  key industry voices  and  Binance representatives  as they share perspectives on the future of blockchain, digital assets, and emerging trends. Games, Giveaways & Experiences:  Participate in interactive games and exclusive Binance activations throughout the event. Food & Drinks:  Enjoy complimentary refreshments while engaging in discussions with fellow attendees. As  a title sponsor of TOKEN2049,  Binance is proud to contribute to the event’s success.  Binance CEO Richard Teng  will be speaking at the event and will appear alongside other Binance leaders and special guests at Binance Clubhouse. The Clubhouse offers a welcoming environment to experience the best of Token2049, and we look forward to hosting you there. Exact location details and full agenda will be shared soon.   To join the waitlist, please register your interest  here .
